user_questions.question: 1) When someone tries to make a second promotion Active on a storefront that already has one, should Salesforce (A) block the save with an error [recommended; the agent actions already return errors as success=false], or (B) automatically set the older promotion to Expired? 2) What counts as 'at a time'? (A) any two promotions with Status__c = Active on the same storefront conflict, regardless of dates [recommended; Status__c is the org's activity flag], or (B) they conflict only when their Start_Date__c/End_Date__c ranges overlap, so a future-dated Active promotion is allowed?
user_questions.simulated_answer: Block with an error rather than auto-expiring the old one. Only prevent a second Active promotion when the date ranges overlap; non-overlapping future-dated active promos are fine.

skill_friction: Step 5 lets the model 'decide yourself' intent answered by org semantics; Status__c = Active suggested the status-only reading, but 'at a time' also pointed to dates. The rule 'points both ways' justified asking, but the boundary between org-semantics-answers-it and ask is judgment-heavy.

RUNNER/skill say to write the exact question before opening intent.json; the skill's single-message rule meant date-boundary (inclusive) and null-date semantics had to be defaulted as assumptions rather than asked, even though they are intent (they change behavior, not inventory).

AskCoworker's I proposal ran one SOQL per storefront and claimed in-batch detection without comparing Trigger.new siblings; skill says fix wrong proposal details without follow-ups, which worked but left R/T sent with the corrected design only described in 'Established so far' bullets, not as a resent I.

AskCoworker repeatedly cited 'prior session' facts (e.g. 21 storefronts, 0 DataStreams) despite the ignore-earlier-conversations header; skill covers verification but not how to count dropping unverifiable ones.
org-verification.md does not note that GenAiFunctionDefinition.InvocationTarget is an id-type field that rejects LIKE; one query failed on that.
